pr_title: Add AOT flag to worker template
pr_body:
The `-aot` flag is available in the `api`, `grpc`, and soon to be in the `console` templates. The `worker` template is compatible with NativeAOT, so it should have the option as well.

Fix #46541
pr_comments: Are there template tests for worker? Should add aot publish

> Are there template tests for worker? Should add aot publish

Done. I left them skipped for now until https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/47247/ is fixed.

issue_context.title: Add AOT flag to worker template
issue_context.body: The worker template is compatible with native AOT. Should there be a flag in the template to enable publishing as AOT?
